notes.title: N0ught Patch 1.1.4
notes.notes: Thanks to N0ught for spotting this bug! The Fine Mask is now assigned as a head item!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.3
notes.notes: Added a fail safe where random number variables are reset to '0' whenever the player sleeps. This should prevent random crashes when entering the Item Shop.

notes.title: Latest patch, sale and exciting news!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.1 is available for download – we have added a new image for each of the 32 possible game endings and 32 corresponding Steam achievements should you complete the game!

To celebrate, we'd like to give you the opportunity to save 15% on Brass Town Wrestling RPG for the week beginning 27/04/2020!

We would also like to announce that our new Indiegogo campaign launches tonight to fund a further five expansions, making the game deeper and more expansive than ever! Visit Indiegogo and search for Brass Town Wrestling to get the latest info! 

Have you already supported Brass Town Wrestling by buying the game here on Steam, or on Itch.io or GameJolt? We’d like to give something back. Send us a screenshot or photo clearly showing the game in your library to brasstownwrestling@gmail.com, and we will send you a link to a hidden perk in the campaign. If you pledge £1, you will get your name featured in the credits and also receive your very own code to unlock the secret supporters area! Here, you will receive your very own dog named Winston who will follow you as you adventure around Brass Town, as well as a Union Jack Flag and Dynamite special item!

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.notes:
1.03
Fixed Inn statue to work at 75 shifts not 100
Made it so that you can't repeatedly use auto shift items
Use a pop up to show time pass in the auto shift items.
*NOTE*
An odd crash occurred where the title screen had vanished with this version. I've fixed this issue, but as it came out of nowhere please pop a comment to the Community section if there are any odd issues (there shouldn't be),

notes.title: Patch 1.02

Updated title screen
Fixed game crash after beating the Naturalist
Added 'Fight Trevor' quest
Ended "The Pyramid" quest after you complete the pyramid.
Stopped player from being able to have the same title match after winning the belt.
